messages:
noah: quick heads-up — final marketplace push is tomorrow 08:00 PT. need confirmations on three lanes: partner demo tokens, onsite hardware cables, and press-kit embargo handoff. please reply with short notes.

 tara: partner tokens — plan to rotate sandbox keys and share secure preview link at T-40m. ttl=2h. i'll post the 1password/secure-share link here when done.

 hugo: hardware — onsite confirmed 2 racks, 4U reserved for AlphaDevices. will need 10Gb uplink and PDUs. tagging logistics-bot for verification.

 logistics-bot: Rack D2 + D3 reserved, PDUs configured, 10Gb uplink provisioned. onsite contact rachel@edgeops.co. shipping ETA T-1d.

 noah: press-bot — whats the embargo schedule and partner preview timing? partners asked for T-30m preview for final QA.

 press-bot: embargo lift 08:00 PT. partners receive secure preview at T-30m (link expires T+90m). press distribution at T via wire and targeted reporters. press kit: https://files.redwood/co/press/5932111111.zip. reminder: no quote edits after lift.

 tara: si note — connectors in staging returned 413 on >10MB files. recommend chunking with 4MB parts and retry up to 6x with jitter. pushing snippet to SI runbook now.

 hugo: CTA call: "Try in Marketplace" chosen for parity with partner listings; marketing confirmed. utm template added: utm_source=partner_marketplace, utm_partner={{partner_slug}}, utm_campaign=summer_launch_2026.

 noah: ops-bot — what's the health gate and rollback behavior if metrics spike?

 ops-bot: rollout window 08:00-08:20 PT. health gate: listing success >= 98% and median page load <850ms sustained over a 5m rolling window. auto-fallback: serve static-catalog bundle if thresholds breached. on rollback, notify eng-oncall and partner-ops; provisioning state requires manual DB revert.

 tara: i'll rotate keys at 06:50 PT and post secure share here. partners to run connector smoke at 09:30 PT and paste logs in this thread for triage.

 hugo: final thumbs — post single word yes/no/blocker.

 noah: yes

 tara: yes

 hugo: yes
